claim_text: Reduce the rate of new occupational illnesses each year.
metric_name: Rate of new occupational illnesses; New occupational health illnesses
context_text: Reduce the rate of new occupational illnesses each year.；7.9% decrease in the rate of new occupational illnesses from 2024.；In 2025, we recorded 196 new occupational health illnesses (2024: 225).
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: 正文和绩效表都显示新职业病从225降至196，对应7.9%下降，直接支持该声明。
notes: 证据合并自绩效目标页与职业健康章节。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the rate of new occupational illnesses is reduced each year. The evidence states a “7.9% decrease in the rate of new occupational illnesses from 2024” and reports fewer new occupational health illnesses in 2025 (196) than in 2024 (225), which is consistent with a year-over-year reduction. No additional qualifiers (scope, boundary, or alternative timeframe) are present in the evidence that would materially limit or contradict the claim as written.
